# Operation Specifications
Member::returnBook
Summary: Processes a return of a borrowed book identified by its title for the supplied date, rejecting returns for books the member does not hold or that are overdue.
Algorithm:
  record = borrowRecords.find(r -> r.book.title equals bookTitle)
  if (record is null) then
      return false
  if (record.isOverdue(today)) then
      return false
  borrowRecords.remove(record)
  return true
Related Features: borrowRecords
Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book, Date
Input: bookTitle - the title of the book to return (String, non-null, must match the title of one of the books currently held by the member); today - the current date on which the return is attempted, formatted as "yyyy-MM-dd"
Output: true when the corresponding BorrowRecord is removed and the return is accepted; false when the member does not currently hold a book with that title, or when the book is overdue (today is strictly after returnDue)
Pre-condition: The Member is initialized; bookTitle is not null
Post-condition: On success, the matching BorrowRecord is removed from borrowRecords and the book is no longer held by the member; on failure, borrowRecords is unchanged and the book remains borrowed

Member::borrowBook
Summary: Processes a borrowing request for a book identified by its title on behalf of the member for the supplied date, enforcing all eligibility constraints.
Algorithm:
  document = library.documents.find(d -> d.title equals bookTitle)
  if (document is null) then
      return false
  if (document is not an instance of Book) then
      return false
  book = (Book) document
  for each member m in library.members do
      for each record r in m.borrowRecords do
          if (r.book == book) then
              return false
  if (borrowRecords.size() >= 3) then
      return false
  dueDate = today + 7 days
  newRecord = new BorrowRecord()
  newRecord.borrowingDate = today
  newRecord.returnDue = dueDate
  newRecord.book = book
  borrowRecords.add(newRecord)
  return true
Related Features: borrowRecords, library
Related Classes: Library, Document, Book, BorrowRecord, Date
Input: bookTitle - the title of the document to borrow (String, non-null, must match the title of an existing document in the library); today - the current date on which the borrowing is attempted, formatted as "yyyy-MM-dd"
Output: true when a new BorrowRecord is created and added to the member's borrowRecords; false when the title is not found, the document is not a Book, the book is currently borrowed by any member, or the member already holds three or more books
Pre-condition: The Member is registered with a valid Library; the bookTitle parameter is not null
Post-condition: On success, a new BorrowRecord with borrowingDate = today and returnDue = today + 7 days is added to borrowRecords; on failure, borrowRecords is unchanged

Member::listBorrowedBookTitles
Summary: Returns the list of titles of all books currently held by the member through active borrow records.
Algorithm:
  result = new empty List<String>
  for each record in borrowRecords do
      result.add(record.book.title)
  return result
Related Features: borrowRecords
Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book
Input: none
Output: A List<String> containing the title of every book referenced by an active BorrowRecord of this member; an empty list when the member has no active borrow records
Pre-condition: The Member is initialized
Post-condition: No state change; the order of returned titles corresponds to the iteration order of borrowRecords

Member::extendReturnDueDate
Summary: Extends the return due date of one of the member's currently borrowed books, identified by title, by delegating the eligibility check and date update to the corresponding BorrowRecord.
Algorithm:
  record = borrowRecords.find(r -> r.book.title equals bookTitle)
  if (record is null) then
      return null
  return record.extendDueDate(today)
Related Features: borrowRecords
Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book, Date
Input: bookTitle - the title of the borrowed book whose due date should be extended (String, non-null); today - the current date used to evaluate eligibility, formatted as "yyyy-MM-dd"
Output: A Date value formatted as "yyyy-MM-dd" representing the (possibly updated) return due date; the new due date when extension is granted, or the original due date when the request falls outside the valid window; null if the member does not currently hold a book with the given title
Pre-condition: The Member is initialized; bookTitle is not null
Post-condition: If the corresponding BorrowRecord is found and today is within [borrowingDate, returnDue), that record's returnDue is advanced by seven days; otherwise, all borrow records remain unchanged

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Operation Specifications
BorrowRecord::extendDueDate
Summary: Extends the return due date of a borrow record by exactly seven days when the extension request is made within the valid time window (i.e., today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date); otherwise, leaves the due date unchanged.
Algorithm:
  if (today is on or after borrowingDate) and (today is strictly before returnDue) then
      returnDue = returnDue + 7 days
      return returnDue
  else
      return returnDue (unchanged)
Related Features: borrowingDate, returnDue
Related Classes: Date
Input: today - the current date used to evaluate eligibility, formatted as "yyyy-MM-dd"
Output: The (possibly updated) return due date as a Date value formatted as "yyyy-MM-dd"; the new due date when the extension is granted, or the original due date when the conditions are not satisfied
Pre-condition: The BorrowRecord has been constructed with a valid borrowingDate and a valid returnDue that is exactly seven days after borrowingDate
Post-condition: If today is within [borrowingDate, returnDue), the returnDue is advanced by seven days; otherwise, returnDue is unchanged

BorrowRecord::isOverdue
Summary: Reports whether this borrow record is overdue as of the supplied date.
Algorithm:
  if (today is strictly after returnDue) then
      return true
  else
      return false
Related Features: returnDue
Related Classes: Date
Input: today - the date to check against the due date, formatted as "yyyy-MM-dd"
Output: true if today is strictly after returnDue, false otherwise (including the case where today equals returnDue)
Pre-condition: The BorrowRecord has been constructed with a valid returnDue
Post-condition: No state change in the BorrowRecord

A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
```text
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Operation Specifications
BorrowRecord::extendDueDate
Summary: Extends the return due date of a borrow record by exactly seven days when the extension request is made within the valid time window (i.e., today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date); otherwise, leaves the due date unchanged.
Algorithm:
  if (today is on or after borrowingDate) and (today is strictly before returnDue) then
      returnDue = returnDue + 7 days
      return returnDue
  else
      return returnDue (unchanged)
Related Features: borrowingDate, returnDue
Related Classes: Date
Input: today - the current date used to evaluate eligibility, formatted as "yyyy-MM-dd"
Output: The (possibly updated) return due date as a Date value formatted as "yyyy-MM-dd"; the new due date when the extension is granted, or the original due date when the conditions are not satisfied
Pre-condition: The BorrowRecord has been constructed with a valid borrowingDate and a valid returnDue that is exactly seven days after borrowingDate
Post-condition: If today is within [borrowingDate, returnDue), the returnDue is advanced by seven days; otherwise, returnDue is unchanged

BorrowRecord::isOverdue
Summary: Reports whether this borrow record is overdue as of the supplied date.
Algorithm:
  if (today is strictly after returnDue) then
      return true
  else
      return false
Related Features: returnDue
Related Classes: Date
Input: today - the date to check against the due date, formatted as "yyyy-MM-dd"
Output: true if today is strictly after returnDue, false otherwise (including the case where today equals returnDue)
Pre-condition: The BorrowRecord has been constructed with a valid returnDue
Post-condition: No state change in the BorrowRecord

   * Summary: Extends the return due date of a borrow record by exactly seven days when the extension request is made within the valid time window (i.e., today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date); otherwise, leaves the due date unchanged.
   * Algorithm:
   *   if (today is on or after borrowingDate) and (today is strictly before returnDue) then
   *       returnDue = returnDue + 7 days
   *       return returnDue
   *   else
   *       return returnDue (unchanged)
   * Related Features: borrowingDate, returnDue
   * Related Classes: Date
   * Input: today - the current date used to evaluate eligibility, formatted as "yyyy-MM-dd"
   * Output: The (possibly updated) return due date as a Date value formatted as "yyyy-MM-dd"; the new due date when the extension is granted, or the original due date when the conditions are not satisfied
   * Pre-condition: The BorrowRecord has been constructed with a valid borrowingDate and a valid returnDue that is exactly seven days after borrowingDate
   * Post-condition: If today is within [borrowingDate, returnDue), the returnDue is advanced by seven days; otherwise, returnDue is unchanged
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model dataType="edu.municipalLibrary.Date" todayDataType="edu.municipalLibrary.Date"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public Date extendDueDate(final Date today)
  {
    Date borrowingDate = getBorrowingDate();
    Date returnDue = getReturnDue();
    if ((!today.before(borrowingDate)) && today.before(returnDue))
    {
      Calendar cal = Calendar.getInstance();
      cal.setTime(returnDue);
      cal.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 7);
      returnDue = cal.getTime();
      setReturnDue(returnDue);
    }
    return returnDue;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Reports whether this borrow record is overdue as of the supplied date.
   * Algorithm:
   *   if (today is strictly after returnDue) then
   *       return true
   *   else
   *       return false
   * Related Features: returnDue
   * Related Classes: Date
   * Input: today - the date to check against the due date, formatted as "yyyy-MM-dd"
   * Output: true if today is strictly after returnDue, false otherwise (including the case where today equals returnDue)
   * Pre-condition: The BorrowRecord has been constructed with a valid returnDue
   * Post-condition: No state change in the BorrowRecord
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model todayDataType="edu.municipalLibrary.Date"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public boolean isOverdue(final Date today)
  {
    return today.after(getReturnDue());
  }

6. Output: output value, including the meaning, the format, and the value ranges if necessary;
7. Pre-condition: the condition that the system and the input must satisfy before the operation is executed;
8. Post-condition: the condition that the system and the output must satisfy after the operation is executed.

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

```plantuml
@startuml

title municipalLibrary Model

class Book {
    bookId : String
}
class BorrowRecord {
    borrowingDate : Date
    returnDue : Date
    book : Book
    extendDueDate(today : Date) : Date
    isOverdue(today : Date) : boolean
}
class Comic {
    recipientName : String
}
class Dictionary {
    dictionaryId : String
}
abstract class Document {
    title : String
}
class Journal {
    publicationDate : Date
}
class Library {
    name : String
    documents : List<Document>
    members : List<Member>
    addDocument(doc : Document) : void
    registerMember(firstName : String, surname : String) : boolean
}
class Member {
    firstName : String
    surname : String
    borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
    library : Library
    borrowBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
    extendReturnDueDate(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : Date
    listBorrowedBookTitles() : List<String>
    returnBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
}
abstract class Volume {
    author : String
}

Book --|> Volume
BorrowRecord --> Book : book
Comic --|> Volume
Dictionary --|> Volume
Journal --|> Document
Library *-- "*" Document : documents
Library *-- "*" Member : members  'opposite: library
Member *-- "*" BorrowRecord : borrowRecords
Member --> Library : library  'opposite: members
Volume --|> Document
@enduml
```

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Class Diagram

```plantuml
title municipalLibrary Model

class Book {
    bookId : String
}
class BorrowRecord {

    returnDue : Date

}

    dictionaryId : String
}

    title : String
}

    publicationDate : Date
}

    name : String
    documents : List<Document>
    members : List<Member>
    addDocument(doc : Document) : void
    registerMember(firstName : String, surname : String) : boolean
}
class Member {
    firstName : String
    surname : String
    borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
    library : Library
    borrowBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
    extendReturnDueDate(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : Date
    listBorrowedBookTitles() : List<String>
    returnBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
}
abstract class Volume {
    author : String
}

Book --|> Volume
BorrowRecord --> Book : book
Comic --|> Volume
Dictionary --|> Volume
Journal --|> Document

@enduml
```

# Operation Specifications
Library::registerMember
Summary: Registers a new member in the library after validating the first name and surname are non-null, non-empty, and not whitespace-only, and after ensuring no existing member already has the same full name. Returns true on success, false on rejection.
Algorithm:
  if (firstName is null OR firstName.trim() is empty) then
      return false
  end if
  if (surname is null OR surname.trim() is empty) then
      return false
  end if
  for each existingMember in members do
      if (existingMember.firstName.equals(firstName) AND existingMember.surname.equals(surname)) then
          return false
      end if
  end for
  newMember = new Member(firstName, surname, empty borrowRecords, this library)
  members.add(newMember)
  return true
Related Features: members
Related Classes: Member
Input:
  firstName (String) - the first name of the new member; must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only.
  surname (String) - the surname of the new member; must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only.
Output: boolean - true when the member is successfully created and added; false when validation or uniqueness checks fail.
Pre-condition: The library has been initialized; firstName and surname are provided (non-null) by the caller.
Post-condition: On success, a new Member is appended to members with an empty borrowRecords list. On failure, the library state is unchanged.

Library::addDocument
Summary: Adds a document (of any concrete Document subtype, e.g. Book, Comic, Dictionary, Journal) to the library's document collection.
Algorithm:
  documents.add(doc)
Related Features: documents
Related Classes: Document
Input: doc (Document) - the document to be added; must not be null and should have a non-null, non-empty title used to uniquely identify the document.
Output: void - nothing is returned.
Pre-condition: doc is a valid Document instance with a unique title; the library exists.
Post-condition: doc is contained in the documents list; the library's document collection size is increased by one.

```text
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Operation Specifications
BorrowRecord::extendDueDate
Summary: Extends the return due date of this borrow record by exactly 7 days when the request is made on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date; otherwise, the due date remains unchanged. The method always returns the (possibly updated) return due date.
Algorithm:
  if (today >= borrowingDate AND today < returnDue) then
      returnDue = returnDue + 7 days
  end if
  return returnDue
Related Features: borrowingDate, returnDue, book
Related Classes: None
Input: today (Date) - the current date in the format "yyyy-MM-dd"; must be a valid calendar date.
Output: Date - the new return due date in the format "yyyy-MM-dd" if the extension was performed, or the unchanged original return due date otherwise.
Pre-condition: The borrow record has been fully initialized with a valid borrowingDate and returnDue, and both dates are in "yyyy-MM-dd" format.
Post-condition: If today lies in the interval [borrowingDate, returnDue), returnDue has been advanced by 7 days; otherwise returnDue is unchanged. The returned value equals the (possibly updated) returnDue.

BorrowRecord::isOverdue
Summary: Reports whether the borrowed book is past its return due date relative to the supplied today date.
Algorithm:
  if (today > returnDue) then
      return true
  else
      return false
  end if
Related Features: returnDue
Related Classes: None
Input: today (Date) - the current date in the format "yyyy-MM-dd"; a valid calendar date.
Output: boolean - true if today is strictly after returnDue (i.e., the book is overdue), false otherwise.
Pre-condition: The borrow record has been initialized with a valid returnDue in "yyyy-MM-dd" format.
Post-condition: The state of the borrow record is unchanged; the method purely reports a derived property.

# Operation Specifications
Member::listBorrowedBookTitles
Summary: Returns the list of titles of all books that the member currently has on loan by collecting the titles from each active borrow record.
Algorithm:
  result = new empty List<String>
  for each r in borrowRecords do
      result.add(r.book.title)
  end for
  return result
Related Features: borrowRecords
Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book
Input: none.
Output: List<String> - a list of book titles (in "yyyy-MM-dd"-free string form) currently borrowed by the member; empty list when the member holds no books.
Pre-condition: The member exists; borrowRecords is a valid list (possibly empty).
Post-condition: The member's internal state is unchanged; a new list containing one entry per borrow record is produced and returned.

Member::returnBook
Summary: Returns a borrowed book identified by title. The return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue; on acceptance the borrow record is removed, otherwise the operation returns false and the borrow record remains active.
Algorithm:
  record = null
  for each r in borrowRecords do
      if (r.book.title.equals(bookTitle)) then
          record = r
          break
      end if
  end for
  if (record is null) then
      return false
  end if
  if (record.isOverdue(today)) then
      return false
  end if
  borrowRecords.remove(record)
  return true
Related Features: borrowRecords
Related Classes: BorrowRecord
Input:
  bookTitle (String) - the title of the book to be returned; non-null, non-empty.
  today (Date) - the current date in the format "yyyy-MM-dd"; used to test whether the book is overdue.
Output: boolean - true when the book was successfully returned and the borrow record was removed; false when the member does not hold that book or the book is overdue.
Pre-condition: The member exists; today is a valid date; borrowRecords is a valid list.
Post-condition: On success, the matching borrow record has been removed from borrowRecords and the book becomes available for borrowing by any member. On failure, borrowRecords is unchanged.

Member::borrowBook
Summary: Allows the member to borrow a book by title on a given day. The operation succeeds only if the title exists in the library, the document is a Book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and this member currently holds fewer than three books. On success, a borrow record with today's borrowing date and a due date exactly 7 days later is created and added to the member's borrow records.
Algorithm:
  if (borrowRecords.size() >= 3) then
      return false
  end if
  targetDoc = null
  for each d in library.documents do
      if (d.title.equals(bookTitle)) then
          targetDoc = d
          break
      end if
  end for
  if (targetDoc is null) then
      return false
  end if
  if (targetDoc is not an instance of Book) then
      return false
  end if
  for each m in library.members do
      for each r in m.borrowRecords do
          if (r.book == targetDoc) then
              return false
          end if
      end for
  end for
  dueDate = today + 7 days
  newRecord = new BorrowRecord(today, dueDate, (Book) targetDoc)
  borrowRecords.add(newRecord)
  return true
Related Features: borrowRecords, library
Related Classes: Library, Book, Document, BorrowRecord
Input:
  bookTitle (String) - the title of the document to be borrowed; must be non-null and non-empty.
  today (Date) - the current date in the format "yyyy-MM-dd"; the borrowing date of the new record.
Output: boolean - true when a new borrow record has been created and added; false when any of the borrowing conditions is not met.
Pre-condition: The member is registered and associated with a non-null library; the library contains a documents list and a members list; today is a valid date.
Post-condition: On success, borrowRecords contains a new BorrowRecord with borrowingDate = today, returnDue = today + 7 days, and the requested Book. The library's document and member collections are unchanged. On failure, the member's borrowRecords and the library state remain unchanged.

Member::extendReturnDueDate
Summary: Extends the return due date of one of this member's currently borrowed books identified by title. The extension is applied by delegating to the matching BorrowRecord::extendDueDate, which moves the due date forward by 7 days when today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, and leaves it unchanged otherwise.
Algorithm:
  record = null
  for each r in borrowRecords do
      if (r.book.title.equals(bookTitle)) then
          record = r
          break
      end if
  end for
  if (record is null) then
      return null
  end if
  return record.extendDueDate(today)
Related Features: borrowRecords
Related Classes: BorrowRecord
Input:
  bookTitle (String) - the title of the borrowed book whose due date is to be extended; non-null, non-empty.
  today (Date) - the current date in the format "yyyy-MM-dd"; used to decide whether extension is allowed.
Output: Date - the new return due date in "yyyy-MM-dd" format if extension was performed, or the unchanged original return due date if extension was not allowed; null if the member does not hold a book with the given title.
Pre-condition: The member exists and today is a valid date; the caller is expected to provide a title of a book currently held by the member.
Post-condition: If the extension conditions are met, the selected borrow record's returnDue is advanced by 7 days and that new value is returned. Otherwise, the selected record's returnDue is unchanged and its original value is returned. If no matching record exists, no borrow record is modified.

If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

```text
5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Operation Specifications
Member::listBorrowedBookTitles
Summary: Returns the list of titles of all books that the member currently has on loan by collecting the titles from each active borrow record.
Algorithm:
  result = new empty List<String>
  for each r in borrowRecords do
      result.add(r.book.title)
  end for
  return result
Related Features: borrowRecords
Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book
Input: none.
Output: List<String> - a list of book titles (in "yyyy-MM-dd"-free string form) currently borrowed by the member; empty list when the member holds no books.
Pre-condition: The member exists; borrowRecords is a valid list (possibly empty).
Post-condition: The member's internal state is unchanged; a new list containing one entry per borrow record is produced and returned.

Member::returnBook
Summary: Returns a borrowed book identified by title. The return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue; on acceptance the borrow record is removed, otherwise the operation returns false and the borrow record remains active.
Algorithm:
  record = null
  for each r in borrowRecords do
      if (r.book.title.equals(bookTitle)) then
          record = r
          break
      end if
  end for
  if (record is null) then
      return false
  end if
  if (record.isOverdue(today)) then
      return false
  end if
  borrowRecords.remove(record)
  return true
Related Features: borrowRecords
Related Classes: BorrowRecord
Input:
  bookTitle (String) - the title of the book to be returned; non-null, non-empty.
  today (Date) - the current date in the format "yyyy-MM-dd"; used to test whether the book is overdue.
Output: boolean - true when the book was successfully returned and the borrow record was removed; false when the member does not hold that book or the book is overdue.
Pre-condition: The member exists; today is a valid date; borrowRecords is a valid list.
Post-condition: On success, the matching borrow record has been removed from borrowRecords and the book becomes available for borrowing by any member. On failure, borrowRecords is unchanged.

Member::borrowBook
Summary: Allows the member to borrow a book by title on a given day. The operation succeeds only if the title exists in the library, the document is a Book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and this member currently holds fewer than three books. On success, a borrow record with today's borrowing date and a due date exactly 7 days later is created and added to the member's borrow records.
Algorithm:
  if (borrowRecords.size() >= 3) then
      return false
  end if
  targetDoc = null
  for each d in library.documents do
      if (d.title.equals(bookTitle)) then
          targetDoc = d
          break
      end if
  end for
  if (targetDoc is null) then
      return false
  end if
  if (targetDoc is not an instance of Book) then
      return false
  end if
  for each m in library.members do
      for each r in m.borrowRecords do
          if (r.book == targetDoc) then
              return false
          end if
      end for
  end for
  dueDate = today + 7 days
  newRecord = new BorrowRecord(today, dueDate, (Book) targetDoc)
  borrowRecords.add(newRecord)
  return true
Related Features: borrowRecords, library
Related Classes: Library, Book, Document, BorrowRecord
Input:
  bookTitle (String) - the title of the document to be borrowed; must be non-null and non-empty.
  today (Date) - the current date in the format "yyyy-MM-dd"; the borrowing date of the new record.
Output: boolean - true when a new borrow record has been created and added; false when any of the borrowing conditions is not met.
Pre-condition: The member is registered and associated with a non-null library; the library contains a documents list and a members list; today is a valid date.
Post-condition: On success, borrowRecords contains a new BorrowRecord with borrowingDate = today, returnDue = today + 7 days, and the requested Book. The library's document and member collections are unchanged. On failure, the member's borrowRecords and the library state remain unchanged.

Member::extendReturnDueDate
Summary: Extends the return due date of one of this member's currently borrowed books identified by title. The extension is applied by delegating to the matching BorrowRecord::extendDueDate, which moves the due date forward by 7 days when today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, and leaves it unchanged otherwise.
Algorithm:
  record = null
  for each r in borrowRecords do
      if (r.book.title.equals(bookTitle)) then
          record = r
          break
      end if
  end for
  if (record is null) then
      return null
  end if
  return record.extendDueDate(today)
Related Features: borrowRecords
Related Classes: BorrowRecord
Input:
  bookTitle (String) - the title of the borrowed book whose due date is to be extended; non-null, non-empty.
  today (Date) - the current date in the format "yyyy-MM-dd"; used to decide whether extension is allowed.
Output: Date - the new return due date in "yyyy-MM-dd" format if extension was performed, or the unchanged original return due date if extension was not allowed; null if the member does not hold a book with the given title.
Pre-condition: The member exists and today is a valid date; the caller is expected to provide a title of a book currently held by the member.
Post-condition: If the extension conditions are met, the selected borrow record's returnDue is advanced by 7 days and that new value is returned. Otherwise, the selected record's returnDue is unchanged and its original value is returned. If no matching record exists, no borrow record is modified.

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Class Diagram
```plantuml
@startuml

title municipalLibrary Model

class Book {
    bookId : String
}
class BorrowRecord {
    borrowingDate : Date
    returnDue : Date
    book : Book
    extendDueDate(today : Date) : Date
    isOverdue(today : Date) : boolean
}
class Comic {
    recipientName : String
}
class Dictionary {
    dictionaryId : String
}
abstract class Document {
    title : String
}
class Journal {
    publicationDate : Date
}
class Library {
    name : String
    documents : List<Document>
    members : List<Member>
    addDocument(doc : Document) : void
    registerMember(firstName : String, surname : String) : boolean
}
class Member {
    firstName : String
    surname : String
    borrowRecords : List<BorrowRecord>
    library : Library
    borrowBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
    extendReturnDueDate(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : Date
    listBorrowedBookTitles() : List<String>
    returnBook(bookTitle : String, today : Date) : boolean
}
abstract class Volume {
    author : String
}

Book --|> Volume
BorrowRecord --> Book : book
Comic --|> Volume
Dictionary --|> Volume
Journal --|> Document
Library *-- "*" Document : documents
Library *-- "*" Member : members  'opposite: library
Member *-- "*" BorrowRecord : borrowRecords
Member --> Library : library  'opposite: members
Volume --|> Document
@enduml
```

You will be given a **Requirement**, a **Class Diagram** in PlantUML, and a list of operation specifications. Your task is to correct the specifications that are inconsistent with the requirement.

8. Post-condition: the condition that the system and the output must satisfy after the operation is executed.

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Operation Specifications
Member::extendReturnDueDate
Summary:
  Extends the return due date of one of this member's currently borrowed
  books, identified by title, by exactly seven days when the supplied
  date satisfies the eligibility condition. Otherwise the original due
  date is returned and no change is made.
Algorithm:
  1. If bookTitle is null or empty, return null.
  2. Find BorrowRecord br in this.borrowRecords whose book.title equals
     bookTitle. If none is found, return null.
  3. Delegate to br.extendDueDate(today) and return the resulting Date.
     (BorrowRecord::extendDueDate enforces "today on/after borrowingDate
      and strictly before current returnDue", performing the +7 day
      update only when the condition holds.)
Related Features:
  - borrowRecords (field, iterated to find the matching record)
Related Classes: BorrowRecord
Input:
  bookTitle : String - the title of a book currently borrowed by this
              member. Must be non-null and non-empty.
  today     : Date   - the current date used to decide whether extension
              is permitted. Format: "yyyy-MM-dd".
Output:
  Date - the new due date (today + 7 days) when extension is permitted;
         the original due date when the condition fails; null when no
         matching BorrowRecord exists. Format: "yyyy-MM-dd".
Pre-condition:
  - The Member exists.
  - today is a valid Date in "yyyy-MM-dd" format.
  - The book identified by bookTitle, if any, is currently in
    this.borrowRecords.
Post-condition:
  - When extension is permitted, the matched BorrowRecord's returnDue is
    advanced by exactly seven days.
  - When the condition is not met, the matched BorrowRecord is unchanged.
  - When no matching record exists, no state change occurs.

Member::listBorrowedBookTitles
Summary:
  Returns the list of titles of all books currently borrowed by this
  member, by collecting the title of the Book referenced by each active
  BorrowRecord. The list is empty when the member holds no borrowed
  books. The order matches the iteration order of borrowRecords.
Algorithm:
  1. Create an empty list titles.
  2. For each BorrowRecord br in this.borrowRecords:
       a. Append br.book.title to titles.
  3. Return titles.
Related Features:
  - borrowRecords (field, iterated to read borrowed book titles)
Related Classes: BorrowRecord, Book
Input: None
Output:
  List<String> - the titles of currently borrowed books in iteration
  order. May be empty. Each entry is a non-null book title in the format
  originally registered in Document.title.
Pre-condition:
  - The Member exists.
Post-condition:
  - No state is changed. The list reflects the borrowRecords at call time.

Member::returnBook
Summary:
  Attempts to return a borrowed book, identified by title, on behalf of
  this member. The return is accepted only when this member currently
  holds that book and the book is not overdue. On success the matching
  BorrowRecord is removed from this member's borrowRecords.
Algorithm:
  1. If bookTitle is null or empty, return false.
  2. Find BorrowRecord br in this.borrowRecords whose book.title equals
     bookTitle. If none is found, return false (member does not hold it).
  3. If br.isOverdue(today) is true, return false (overdue - rejected,
     record stays active).
  4. Remove br from this.borrowRecords.
  5. Return true.
Related Features:

Related Classes: BorrowRecord
Input:

              and non-empty. Matched exactly against BorrowRecord.book.title.
  today     : Date   - the current date used by BorrowRecord.isOverdue
              to determine whether the book is past its due date.
              Format: "yyyy-MM-dd".
Output:
  boolean - true when the BorrowRecord is removed (return accepted);
            false when the member does not hold the book or the book
            is overdue.
Pre-condition:
  - The Member exists.
  - today is a valid Date in "yyyy-MM-dd" format.
Post-condition:
  - On success: the matched BorrowRecord is removed from borrowRecords.
  - On failure: borrowRecords is unchanged (in particular, overdue records
    remain active as required).

Member::borrowBook
Summary:
  Attempts to borrow, on behalf of this member, the document identified
  by the given title. The request is accepted only when the title exists
  in the library, the document is a Book, the book is not currently
  borrowed by any member, and this member currently holds fewer than
  three borrowed books. On success a new BorrowRecord is created and

       - borrowingDate = today
       - returnDue     = dueDate
       - book          = d
  8. Append the new BorrowRecord to this.borrowRecords.

  - borrowRecords (field, read for size check and appended to)
Related Classes: Library, Document, Book, BorrowRecord

Pre-condition:
  - The Member and its associated Library exist.
  - The Library contains a Document whose title equals bookTitle.
  - today is a valid Date in "yyyy-MM-dd" format.
Post-condition:
  - On success: a new BorrowRecord (borrowingDate=today,
    returnDue=today+7 days, book=d) is added to this.borrowRecords.
  - On failure: borrowRecords is unchanged.

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Operation Specifications
BorrowRecord::isOverdue
Summary:
  Reports whether this borrow record is overdue with respect to the
  supplied current date. A record is overdue when today is strictly later
  than the recorded return due date.
Algorithm:
  1. If today > returnDue, return true.
  2. Otherwise, return false.
Related Features:
  - returnDue (field, read for comparison)
Related Classes: None
Input:
  today : Date - the current calendar date. Format: "yyyy-MM-dd".
Output:
  boolean - true if today is strictly after the return due date,
            false otherwise.
Pre-condition:
  - The BorrowRecord exists with a valid returnDue in "yyyy-MM-dd" format.
  - today is a valid Date in "yyyy-MM-dd" format.
Post-condition:
  - The BorrowRecord state is unchanged.

BorrowRecord::extendDueDate
Summary:
  Extends the return due date of this borrow record by exactly seven days
  when the supplied date satisfies the eligibility condition
  (today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current
  due date). When the condition is not satisfied, the due date is left
  unchanged. The resulting due date is always returned.
Algorithm:
  1. If today < borrowingDate OR today >= returnDue:
       a. return returnDue (unchanged original due date).
  2. newDueDate = returnDue + 7 days.
  3. returnDue = newDueDate.
  4. return newDueDate.
Related Features:
  - borrowingDate (field, read for eligibility check)
  - returnDue     (field, read and possibly updated)
Related Classes: None
Input:
  today : Date - the current calendar date used to decide whether
         extension is allowed and to compute the new due date.
         Format: "yyyy-MM-dd".
Output:
  Date - the new return due date when extension succeeds, otherwise the
  unchanged original due date. Format: "yyyy-MM-dd".
Pre-condition:
  - The BorrowRecord has been properly constructed with a valid
    borrowingDate and returnDue.
  - today is a valid Date in format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Post-condition:
  - If extension is permitted, returnDue is advanced by exactly seven days
    and the new date is returned.
  - If extension is not permitted, returnDue is unchanged and the original
    due date is returned.

# Operation Specifications
Library::addDocument
Summary:
  Adds a document (any subclass of Document such as Book, Journal,
  Dictionary or Comic) to the library's document collection.
Algorithm:
  1. If doc is null, do nothing and return.
  2. Append doc to the documents list.
Related Features:
  - documents (field, appended to)
Related Classes: Document
Input:
  doc : Document - the document instance to register in the library.
        Must not be null. The concrete subtype (Book, Journal, etc.) is
        preserved in the documents list.
Output:
  void - no return value.
Pre-condition:
  - The Library instance exists.
  - doc is not null and its title is non-null/non-empty (assumed to be
    upheld by the caller; the operation itself only checks for null).
Post-condition:
  - doc is added to the documents collection of the Library so that it
    can be discovered in subsequent borrowing operations.

Library::registerMember
Summary:
  Registers a new member in the library using the supplied first name and
  surname. Validation rejects empty/whitespace names and duplicate full
  names. A successful registration appends a new Member to the library's
  members list and returns true; any rejected attempt returns false
  without mutating state.
Algorithm:
  1. If firstName is null, empty, or contains only whitespace, return false.
  2. If surname  is null, empty, or contains only whitespace, return false.
  3. For each existing member m in members:
       a. If m.firstName equals firstName AND m.surname equals surname,
          return false (duplicate full name).
  4. Create new Member instance with:
       - firstName     = firstName
       - surname       = surname
       - borrowRecords = empty list
       - library       = this Library

# Requirement
```text
We want to automate the management of a small municipal library. The library has a name and manages a collection of documents and a set of registered members. Members have a first name and a surname. Documents are uniquely identified by their title. Every document has a title. A volume is a kind of document and also has an author. A book is a kind of volume and also has a bookId that identifies the physical or catalogued copy. A dictionary is a kind of volume and also has a dictionaryId that identifies the dictionary entry in the library catalog. A comic is also a kind of volume and has a recipient name. A journal is a kind of document and has a publication date. Only books can be borrowed.
A registered member can borrow or return a book, and the system must always be able to list the titles currently borrowed by that member. A member can hold at most three borrowed books at the same time. When a borrowing succeeds, the system creates a borrow record containing the borrowing date, the borrowed book, and a return due date exactly seven days later. A borrowed book can be extended on request when the request is made before the current due date. A return is accepted only when the member currently holds that book and the book is not overdue. The system records dates in the format "yyyy-MM-dd".
Functional requirement:
1. Register a new member. The library registers a new member from a first name and a surname. The first name and surname must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only. The library rejects a registration when another member already has exactly the same full name. A successful registration creates the member with no borrowed books and returns true. Any rejected registration returns false.

2. Borrow a book and create a record in the system. A member borrows a document by title. The library accepts the request only when the title exists, the document is a book, the book is not already borrowed by any member, and the member currently holds fewer than three books. A successful borrowing creates a borrow record with today's date as the borrowing date and a due date exactly seven days later, then returns true. Any rejected borrowing returns false.

3. Extend a borrowed record's return due date. A member may extend the due date of one of their own borrowed books by title. When today is on or after the borrowing date and strictly before the current due date, the library moves the due date forward by seven days and returns the new due date. Otherwise, the due date remains unchanged and the original due date is returned.

4. Return a book. A member returns a borrowed book by title. If the member does not currently hold that title, the operation returns false. If the borrowed book is overdue, the return is rejected, the borrow record remains active, and the operation returns false. Otherwise the borrow record is removed and the operation returns true.

5. List all borrowed book titles for a member. A member can list the titles of all currently borrowed books. If the member has no active borrowed books, the operation returns an empty list.
```

# Operation Specifications
Library::addDocument
Summary:
  Adds a document (any subclass of Document such as Book, Journal,
  Dictionary or Comic) to the library's document collection.
Algorithm:
  1. If doc is null, do nothing and return.
  2. Append doc to the documents list.
Related Features:
  - documents (field, appended to)
Related Classes: Document
Input:
  doc : Document - the document instance to register in the library.
        Must not be null. The concrete subtype (Book, Journal, etc.) is
        preserved in the documents list.
Output:
  void - no return value.
Pre-condition:
  - The Library instance exists.
  - doc is not null and its title is non-null/non-empty (assumed to be
    upheld by the caller; the operation itself only checks for null).
Post-condition:
  - doc is added to the documents collection of the Library so that it
    can be discovered in subsequent borrowing operations.

Library::registerMember
Summary:
  Registers a new member in the library using the supplied first name and
  surname. Validation rejects empty/whitespace names and duplicate full
  names. A successful registration appends a new Member to the library's
  members list and returns true; any rejected attempt returns false
  without mutating state.
Algorithm:
  1. If firstName is null, empty, or contains only whitespace, return false.
  2. If surname  is null, empty, or contains only whitespace, return false.
  3. For each existing member m in members:
       a. If m.firstName equals firstName AND m.surname equals surname,
          return false (duplicate full name).
  4. Create new Member instance with:
       - firstName     = firstName
       - surname       = surname
       - borrowRecords = empty list
       - library       = this Library
  5. Append the new Member to members.
  6. Return true.
Related Features:
  - members (field, appended to when registration succeeds)
Related Classes: Member
Input:
  firstName : String - first name of the new member.
              Must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only.
  surname   : String - surname of the new member.
              Must not be null, empty, or whitespace-only.
Output:
  boolean - true when a new Member has been created and added to the
            library; false when the request is rejected for any reason
            (invalid input or duplicate full name).
Pre-condition:
  - The Library instance exists.
Post-condition:
  - On success: a new Member (with no borrowed books) is added to
    members and true is returned.
  - On failure: members is unchanged and false is returned.

   *   2. If doc.title is null, empty, or contains only whitespace,
   *      do nothing and return.
   *   3. For each existing document d in documents:
   *        a. If d.title equals doc.title, do nothing and return
   *           (duplicate title violates the unique-title invariant).
   *   4. Append doc to the documents list.
   * Related Features:
   *   - documents (field, appended to when all validation passes)
   * Related Classes: Document
   * Input:
   *   doc : Document - the document instance to register in the library.
   *         Must not be null. Must carry a non-null, non-empty,
   *         non-whitespace-only title. The concrete subtype (Book,
   *         Journal, etc.) is preserved in the documents list.
   * Output:
   *   void - no return value.
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - The Library instance exists.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - If all validation passes, doc is added to the documents
   *     collection of the Library so that it can be discovered in
   *     subsequent borrowing operations.
   *   - If any validation fails (null doc, invalid title, or duplicate
   *     title), the documents collection is unchanged and the
   *     unique-title / every-document-has-a-title invariant is
   *     preserved.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void addDocument(final Document doc)
  {
    // 1. Reject null documents.
    if (doc == null)
    {
      return;
    }
    // 2. Reject documents with an invalid title.
    String title = doc.getTitle();
    if (title == null || title.trim().isEmpty())
    {
      return;
    }
    // 3. Reject documents whose title duplicates an existing document's title.
    for (Document d : getDocuments())
    {
      if (title.equals(d.getTitle()))
      {
        return;
      }
    }
    // 4. Append the document to the library's documents list.
    getDocuments().add(doc);
  }

```java
public boolean borrowBook(final String bookTitle, final Date today)
{
  if (bookTitle == null || bookTitle.isEmpty())
  {
    return false;
  }
  Library library = getLibrary();
  Document d = null;
  for (Document doc : library.getDocuments())
  {
    if (bookTitle.equals(doc.getTitle()))
    {
      d = doc;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (d == null)
  {
    return false;
  }
  if (!(d instanceof Book))
  {
    return false;
  }
  for (Member m : library.getMembers())
  {
    for (BorrowRecord br : m.getBorrowRecords())
    {
      if (br.getBook() == d)
      {
        return false;
      }
    }
  }
  if (this.getBorrowRecords().size() >= 3)
  {
    return false;
  }

  cal.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 7);

}
```

```java
public boolean returnBook(final String bookTitle, final Date today)
{
  if (bookTitle == null || bookTitle.isEmpty())
  {
    return false;
  }
  BorrowRecord target = null;
  for (BorrowRecord br : this.getBorrowRecords())
  {
    Book book = br.getBook();
    if (book != null && bookTitle.equals(book.getTitle()))
    {
      target = br;
      break;
    }
  }
  if (target == null)
  {
    return false;
  }
  if (target.isOverdue(today))
  {
    return false;
  }
  this.getBorrowRecords().remove(target);
  return true;
}
```

    {
      if (bookTitle.equals(doc.getTitle()))
      {
        targetDoc = doc;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (targetDoc == null)
    {
      return false;
    }

    if (!(targetDoc instanceof Book))
    {
      return false;
    }

    for (Member m : library.getMembers())
    {
      for (BorrowRecord br : m.getBorrowRecords())
      {
        if (br.getBook() == targetDoc)
        {
          return false;
        }
      }
    }

    if (getBorrowRecords().size() >= 3)
    {
      return false;
    }

    Calendar cal = Calendar.getInstance();
    cal.setTime(today);
    cal.add(Calendar.DAY_OF_MONTH, 7);
    Date dueDate = cal.getTime();

    BorrowRecord newRecord = MunicipalLibraryFactory.eINSTANCE.createBorrowRecord();
    newRecord.setBorrowingDate(today);
    newRecord.setReturnDue(dueDate);
    newRecord.setBook((Book) targetDoc);
    getBorrowRecords().add(newRecord);
    return true;
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary:
   *   Attempts to return a borrowed book, identified by title, on behalf of
   *   this member. The return is accepted only when this member currently
   *   holds that book and the book is not overdue. On success the matching
   *   BorrowRecord is removed from this member's borrowRecords.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If bookTitle is null or empty, return false.
   *   2. Find BorrowRecord br in this.borrowRecords whose book.title equals
   *      bookTitle. If none is found, return false (member does not hold it).
   *   3. If br.isOverdue(today) is true, return false (overdue - rejected,
   *      record stays active).
   *   4. Remove br from this.borrowRecords.
   *   5. Return true.
   * Related Features:
   *   - borrowRecords (field, searched and possibly mutated)
   * Related Classes: BorrowRecord
   * Input:
   *   bookTitle : String - the title of the book to return. Must be non-null
   *               and non-empty. Matched exactly against BorrowRecord.book.title.
   *   today     : Date   - the current date used by BorrowRecord.isOverdue
   *               to determine whether the book is past its due date.
   *               Format: "yyyy-MM-dd".
   * Output:
   *   boolean - true when the BorrowRecord is removed (return accepted);
   *             false when the member does not hold the book or the book
   *             is overdue.
   * Pre-condition:
   *   - The Member exists.
   *   - today is a valid Date in "yyyy-MM-dd" format.
   * Post-condition:
   *   - On success: the matched BorrowRecord is removed from borrowRecords.
   *   - On failure: borrowRecords is unchanged (in particular, overdue records
   *     remain active as required).
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model todayDataType="edu.municipalLibrary.Date"
   *        annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public boolean returnBook(final String bookTitle, final Date today)
  {
    if (bookTitle == null || bookTitle.isEmpty())
    {
      return false;
    }

    BorrowRecord target = null;
    for (BorrowRecord br : getBorrowRecords())
    {
      Book book = br.getBook();
      if (book != null && bookTitle.equals(book.getTitle()))
      {
        target = br;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (target == null)
    {
      return false;
    }

    if (target.isOverdue(today))
    {
      return false;
    }

    getBorrowRecords().remove(target);
    return true;
  }

  /**

   * @generated NOT

  public Date extendReturnDueDate(final String bookTitle, final Date today)
  {
    for (BorrowRecord br : getBorrowRecords())
    {
      Book book = br.getBook();
      if (book != null && bookTitle.equals(book.getTitle()))
      {
        return br.extendDueDate(today);
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->

   * @generated NOT

  public EList<String> listBorrowedBookTitles()
  {
    EList<String> titles = new BasicEList<String>();
    for (BorrowRecord br : getBorrowRecords())
    {
      Book book = br.getBook();
      if (book != null)
      {
        titles.add(book.getTitle());
      }
    }
    return titles;
  }
